name: OpenShift 4.21 Foundations
description: Establishes the core Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) 4.21 foundation, encompassing installation strategies, identity provider integration, and the stabilization of core operators.

alphas.name: OpenShift Cluster
alphas.description: The OCP 4.21 cluster instance, defined by its control plane, compute nodes, and core cluster operators.

states.name: Topology Defined
states.description: The cluster architecture (IPI vs UPI, network, and storage) is selected.

checklist.name: Network Sized
checklist.description: Machine CIDR, Pod CIDR, and Service CIDR are allocated.

states.name: Bootstrapped
states.description: The temporary bootstrap node has ignited the control plane.

checklist.name: API Responding
checklist.description: The Kubernetes API server is accessible.

states.name: Operators Stabilized
states.description: The Cluster Version Operator (CVO) reports all core operators as Available.

checklist.name: CVO Available
checklist.description: No cluster operators are reporting degraded states.

checklist.name: Bootstrap Destroyed
checklist.description: The temporary bootstrap machine has been safely decommissioned.

alphas.name: Cluster Identity & Access
alphas.description: The integration of enterprise authentication and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

checklist.name: Identity Sync Planned
checklist.description: LDAP or OIDC sync parameters are defined.

states.name: Authentication Active
states.description: The OAuth operator is configured and active.

checklist.name: Users Synced
checklist.description: External identity provider users can authenticate to the API and Console.

activities.name: Generate Installation Manifests
activities.description: Create and customize the install-config.yaml for the target 4.21 environment.

activities.name: Execute Cluster Bootstrap
activities.description: Run the OpenShift installer to deploy the bootstrap and control plane nodes.

activities.name: Configure Enterprise OAuth
activities.description: Apply the OAuth custom resource to integrate the enterprise identity provider.

workProducts.name: Cluster Install Configuration
workProducts.description: The declarative install-config.yaml defining the core parameters of the OpenShift deployment.

levelsOfDetail.name: Drafted
levelsOfDetail.description: Base domain, cluster name, and pull secret are provided.

checklist.name: Pull Secret Attached
checklist.description: Red Hat registry pull secret is included.

checklist.name: SSH Key Provided
checklist.description: Core user SSH key is added for emergency access.

levelsOfDetail.name: Applied
levelsOfDetail.description: The configuration has been consumed by the openshift-install binary.

checklist.name: Ignition Generated
checklist.description: Ignition configs for bootstrap, master, and worker are created.

workProducts.name: Identity Provider Manifest
workProducts.description: The Kubernetes Custom Resource (CR) defining the OAuth configuration.

levelsOfDetail.name: Drafted
levelsOfDetail.description: Mapping method and provider credentials (e.g., clientSecret) are defined.

checklist.name: Secret Created
checklist.description: OAuth client secret is staged in the openshift-config namespace.

levelsOfDetail.name: Applied
levelsOfDetail.description: The OAuth CR has been applied to the cluster.

checklist.name: Pods Rolled
checklist.description: Authentication operator has successfully rolled out the new configuration.

workBreakdowns.name: OCP Base Infrastructure Delivery
workBreakdowns.description: The execution plan for delivering a fully operational OpenShift 4.21 cluster foundation.

complexity.name: Standard IPI Complexity
complexity.description: Standard risk profile for Installer Provisioned Infrastructure (IPI) on supported public clouds.

task.name: Run installer binary
task.description: Execute the openshift-install create cluster command and monitor logs.

task.name: Apply OAuth configuration
task.description: Deploy the identity provider manifests and verify user login.
